title: Manual deposit
subtitle: Record the money the bank actually credited for this transfer.

state.heading: State reported by the server
state.pending: The server has not reported a deposit for this tender yet.
state.outcomeHint: Recorded when the server accepted this movement. It is evidence of that deposit, not what the tender owes today.
state.absent: This tender no longer appears in the server's current transfer list, so no live balance is shown. It may already be settled.
state.notRefreshed: The tender's current state could not be refreshed, so no live balance is shown.

fields.referenceHint: The reference that appears on the bank statement.
fields.amountHint: Exactly what the bank credited; the server totals the deposits.

validation.amountRequired: Enter the amount the bank credited.

permission.denied: Only a manager or an administrator can record a deposit.

history.heading: Deposit history
history.description: Movements this sale reports to the server.
history.error: The history could not be loaded.
history.empty: The server reports no transfer movements for this sale yet.

errors.failed: The deposit could not be recorded.
